markets.question: Team Total Defensive/Special Teams Touchdowns: Over 0.5

Overtime is included if played. Defensive/special teams touchdowns include interception returns, opponent-fumble returns, blocked-kick returns, kickoff returns, and punt returns; offensive touchdowns do not count. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended before this market is determined and is not resumed or rescheduled within two days of the originally scheduled date, it will be flagged for manual last-fair-market-price settlement.
